description: This is a test class for the SoftKeyboard implementation in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It extends SoftKeyboard and provides methods to simulate user interactions, manage internal components, and mock dependencies for testing purposes.

classes.name: OverlayCreatorForSpy
classes.description: A wrapper class for OverlyDataCreator that delegates createOverlayData calls to the original creator, used for spying in tests.

classes.name: TestableKeyboardSwitcher
classes.description: A subclass of KeyboardSwitcher with additional methods to verify internal state changes during tests.

classes.name: TestableSuggest
classes.description: A wrapper for Suggest that delegates all calls, used to facilitate spying and testing.

methods.name: createOverlayDataCreator
methods.description: Creates a spy wrapper around the overlay data creator for testing.

methods.name: getSuggest
methods.description: Returns the Suggest instance, possibly a spy for testing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes mock dependencies and sets up the test environment.

methods.name: simulateKeyPress
methods.description: Simulates a key press event with specified key code.

methods.name: simulateTextTyping
methods.description: Simulates typing a string of text, optionally advancing time.

methods.name: simulateCurrentSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Simulates a change in the input method subtype.

methods.name: getLastOnKeyPrimaryCode
methods.description: Returns the primary code of the last key pressed.

methods.name: getTestInputConnection
methods.description: Returns the test input connection instance.

methods.name: getCurrentInputConnectionText
methods.description: Returns the current text in the input connection.

methods.name: moveCursorToPosition
methods.description: Moves the cursor to a specified position.

methods.name: setSelectedText
methods.description: Sets the selection range in the input connection.

methods.name: getCreatedInputMethodSessionInterface
methods.description: Returns the created input method session.

methods.name: getCreatedInputMethodInterface
methods.description: Returns the created input method interface.

methods.name: getCurrentTestInputConnection
methods.description: Returns the current test input connection.

methods.name: isKeyboardViewHidden
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard view is hidden.
